description: This file provides a utility function `formatStatusLabel` that converts raw deployment status codes into human-readable labels, with specific formatting rules such as replacing underscores/hyphens, collapsing spaces, and applying Title Case. methods.name: formatStatusLabel(value)
methods.description: Converts a raw status code string into a human-readable, Title Cased label, handling null/undefined, replacing delimiters with spaces, collapsing extra spaces, and properly capitalizing words including those following apostrophes.
